name: Rice vinegar
description: Mild pale vinegar from fermented rice — the gentlest of the family.

tcm.note: Cu is warm, sour and astringent; it enters the liver and moves stagnation.

ayurveda.note: Shukta is ushna, whatever grain it comes from.

unani.note: Sirka is garam-khushk in the Unani record.

histamine.note: Mild and not wine-based, so it sits with the tolerated vinegars rather than with balsamic — it is often suggested as the substitute.

effects.note: Acetic acid taken with a meal measurably blunts the blood glucose spike that follows — a meta-analysis of eleven trials found a real, if inconsistent, reduction in post-meal glucose and insulin response, with notable heterogeneity between studies. A splash in a dressed salad or dipping sauce is close to trial doses. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
